title: Unique Umami German Pork Skewers
description: Tender pork skewers with a sweet and savory umami flavor, featuring maple syrup and char-grill yang, perfect for a diabetic-friendly dinner option.
instructions: Preheat the robata grill to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together maple syrup, apple cider vinegar, Dijon mustard, smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Add the pork cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated pork cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the grill with oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, or until the pork reaches an internal temperature of 145 degrees.
Let the skewers rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve hot.
Serve with a side of roasted vegetables or a salad for a well-rounded meal.
